mapper.sql: id, seq, tenant_id, identity_type, display_name, source, status, external_key, employee_id, org_id, org_path, attributes, risk_level, owner_identity_id, expired_at, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO oa_iam.identity ( id, tenant_id, identity_type, display_name, source, status, external_key, employee_id, org_id, org_path, attributes, risk_level, owner_identity_id, expired_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{tenantId}, #{identityType}, #{displayName}, #{source}, #{status}, #{externalKey}, #{employeeId}, #{orgId}, #{orgPath}, #{attributes, typeHandler=com.lrj.oa.common.mybatis.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{riskLevel},
CAST(#{ownerIdentityId} AS uuid) NULL , #{expiredAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM oa_iam.identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_iam.identity SET display_name = #{displayName}, expired_at = #{expiredAt}, owner_identity_id = CAST(#{ownerIdentityId} AS uuid) NULL , version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND version = #{version} AND status <> 'DELETED'

UPDATE oa_iam.identity SET display_name = #{displayName}, status = #{status}, org_id = #{orgId}, org_path = #{orgPath}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oa_iam.identity_label WHERE identity_id = CAST(#{identityId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_iam.identity_label (identity_id, label) VALUES (CAST(#{identityId} AS uuid), #{label}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT label FROM oa_iam.identity_label WHERE identity_id = CAST(#{identityId} AS uuid) ORDER BY label

SELECT identity_id AS identityId, label FROM oa_iam.identity_label WHERE identity_id IN
CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
ORDER BY label

SELECT FROM oa_iam.identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id IN
CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CREATED') ORDER BY seq
SELECT FROM oa_iam.identity WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_identity_id = CAST(#{ownerIdentityId} AS uuid) AND status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY seq LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_iam.identity ( id, tenant_id, identity_type, display_name, source, status, external_key, employee_id, org_id, org_path, risk_level, version ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), e.tenant_id, 'USER', e.name, 'CASDOOR', CASE e.status WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN 'LEAVING' THEN 'SUSPENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, e.user_id, e.id, a.org_unit_id, u.path, 'LOW', 0 FROM oa_org.employee e LEFT JOIN oa_org.employee_org_assignment a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND a.valid_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN oa_org.org_unit u ON u.id = a.org_unit_id ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, identity_type, external_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_iam.identity i SET display_name = e.name, status = CASE e.status WHEN 'LEFT' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN 'LEAVING' THEN 'SUSPENDED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END, org_id = a.org_unit_id, org_path = u.path, version = i.version + 1, updated_at = now() FROM oa_org.employee e LEFT JOIN oa_org.employee_org_assignment a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND a.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND a.valid_to IS NULL LEFT JOIN oa_org.org_unit u ON u.id = a.org_unit_id WHERE i.employee_id = e.id AND i.identity_type = 'USER' AND i.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND i.status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_iam.identity_label (identity_id, label) SELECT i.id, CASE WHEN e.employment_type IN ('OUTSOURCE', 'CONSULTANT') THEN 'CONTRACTOR' ELSE 'EMPLOYEE' END FROM oa_iam.identity i JOIN oa_org.employee e ON e.id = i.employee_id WHERE i.identity_type = 'USER' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
